issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is referenced but never defined or imported in the diff
issues.detail: The diff changes self._enable_vad to test membership against [EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED, EndOfUtteranceMode.EXTERNAL], yet only TurnDetectionMode.FIXED is added to the enum visible here. If EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED does not exist as an enum member in the imported speechmatics package, this will raise AttributeError at construction time. The author has not stated the precondition that EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED must exist in the linked library version 0.0.99+, nor any guard for older versions. Either prove that member exists in the dependency contract or refuse the change.

issues.description: Default behavior change is silently breaking for existing users
issues.detail: Changing the default from TurnDetectionMode.EXTERNAL to TurnDetectionMode.FIXED is a semantic default flip. Any existing caller who relied on the documented default 'external' (Pipecat's built-in endpointing path described in the original docstring) will now silently take a different code path that finalizes only on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. There is no deprecation path, no warning, and no migration note in the changelog. This is the classic 'we tested it' fallacy: the postcondition for existing users has changed without being reasoned about.

issues.description: Frame-type discrimination by isinstance with no stated invariant
issues.detail: process_frame previously finalized on UserStoppedSpeakingFrame and now finalizes only on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. The author has not stated the invariant connecting these frame types: is VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame a subclass of UserStoppedSpeakingFrame, a sibling, or unrelated? If the former, the isinstance check still matches both and the warning text lies; if the latter, any pipeline emitting only UserStoppedSpeakingFrame will no longer trigger finalization. The control flow is unreasoned and the postcondition is ambiguous.

issues.description: Dead conditional branch via tautological structure
issues.detail: The structure 'if self._enable_vad: warn; elif not self._enable_vad and self._client is not None: finalize' is the smuggled-goto pattern: a boolean and its negation as sibling branches. The 'and self._client is not None' rider hides a precondition that should be stated explicitly at function entry. Refactor to: if self._enable_vad: warn; return. if self._client is None: return (or assert). self._client.finalize(). The current form invites a reader to simulate it; structured selection should not.

issues.description: split_sentences typed Optional[bool] but coerced with 'or False' — three-valued logic without justification
issues.detail: params.split_sentences is declared bool | None and then passed as 'params.split_sentences or False'. If None means 'use the library default', that intent is destroyed by the coercion. If None is equivalent to False, the type should be bool with default False. The author has not stated which interpretation holds; the postcondition is therefore unspecified. Pick one and state it.

issues.description: Commented-out metric call moved with no explanation
issues.detail: The line '# await self.start_processing_metrics()' is relocated from after push_interruption_task_frame_and_wait() to before broadcast_frame. Commented code carries no semantics and should be deleted, not reordered. Either the metric belongs (uncomment and reason about ordering) or it does not (remove). Leaving rearranged dead code is a confession that the author has not decided.

issues.description: Changelog inconsistency: 'added' file documents split_sentences; 'fixed' file documents the turn-detection rewiring; the PR description omits split_sentences entirely
issues.detail: The PR description enumerates three changes and never mentions split_sentences, yet the diff adds a parameter, an InputParams field, a config wiring, and a changelog entry for it. A reviewer cannot reconcile the stated scope with the delivered scope. Either the PR description is incomplete or split_sentences was smuggled in.

review.summary: UNREASONED. The change rests on two assumptions the author has not proved: that EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED exists in the dependency at 0.0.99+, and that flipping the public default from EXTERNAL to FIXED is safe for existing callers. SMUGGLED-GOTO appears in the process_frame branch where 'if enable_vad / elif not enable_vad and client is not None' replaces a stated precondition with a negated-flag chain. TESTED-NOT-PROVED is the operative diagnosis for the default-flip: no invariant is offered for downstream pipelines still emitting UserStoppedSpeakingFrame rather than VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. REFUSED until the author states the precondition on the dependency version, the postcondition for existing callers, and the invariant relating the two frame types — and until the commented-out metric line is either deleted or owned.
